title: Measurement unit definition
reason:
Provisional Phase 1 concept only. Fresh Phase 2 must decide existing-meaning reuse, equivalence and distinctions. It is not a canonical definition or accepted source mapping.

Phase 2 UNRESOLVED: Quantity kind, unit identifier, measured value, ordinal rating and packaging are distinct. Conversion requires both reviewed units and compatible quantity kinds, including scale/offset and product quantity for packaging. BOX is not a mass unit; weight unit code is not weight; film rating is not physical measurement. Retain datum, unit, interval and quality metadata. Definition gap: the candidate combines source roles or lacks a sufficiently bounded reusable definition and binding domain. Retain the candidate; do not infer absence from literal query results.
